interface.longDescription:
Turn a mood, activity, genre, or song list into a music playlist with AI, then save it to Spotify. Make a workout mix, find music for a road trip, or build a playlist around your favorite artists.

Search Spotify songs, add or remove tracks, rename playlists, update descriptions and privacy, and reorder songs in playlists you own. Browse your accessible public playlists and their songs in a playlist browser on supported hosts. Set your preferred privacy for newly created playlists.

A connected Spotify account is required. Playlist browsing is limited to the public playlists available through the current Spotify permissions; private and collaborative library browsing is unavailable. You can create private playlists. Song availability varies, and unmatched songs or partial results are reported. Panels depend on your host. This release supports Spotify only and does not control playback, provide listening-history statistics, or manage subscriptions.

review.commerce_description: This Spotify plugin has no paid feature gate, purchase links, checkout, or payment processing. It creates and manages playlists through a connected Spotify account.
